title: A rail file: res/field/rails/<rails>/rails.json
description: One rail file of the rail archive (a/0/7/8), which FieldRailLoader_LoadFile reads (src/ov036/field_rail_loader.c): the points, lines, cameras and curves of a map without a grid. The lines and points name each other, the cameras and curves, and the zones' events place NPCs, warps and triggers on the rails, all by index, so an entry's place in its list is its ID. Positions and distances are fx32, in 4096ths of a unit, as integers. The tiles' attributes are in attributes/line_NN.csv beside this file. tools/data/rail_data.py packs it.

unk0.description: The header's first word, which the game doesn't read; every file has 347218 (0x54c52)

tile_width.description: The size of a tile of the rails, fx32 (RailDataHandle's tileWidth); 4096 in every file

id.description: An ID of a point, line, camera or curve; 65535 (RAIL_ID_NONE) for none

dir.description: A direction on the rails: 0 none, 1 up, 2 right, 3 down, 4 left (RAIL_DIR_*)

name.description: The point's name, at most 48 characters, which the file pads with spaces

lines.description: The lines that meet at the point, 65535 in a free slot

dirs.description: The direction of each slot's line from the point

widths.description: The width of each slot's line at the point, in sixteenths of a tile

pos.description: Where the point is in the world

name.description: The line's name, at most 47 characters, which the file pads with zeros

point_a.description: The point where the line starts

dir.description: The direction from point_a to point_b

curve.description: The curve that bends the line

func.description: The camera function to call, an index of the rail system's camera functions

params.description: The function's parameters (RailCamera's unk4 to unk20)

handler.description: The pair of functions that convert between rail and world positions, an index of the rail system's railToWorld and worldToRail functions

unk10.description: RailCurve's last 20 bytes, zero when left out, as in every file
